meta.title: Invite a vendor by entering details manually

args.goal: On the open Invite Vendor side drawer, select "Enter details manually", verify that Company Name, Address, and City are shown as required, enter the provided company name and address, choose the provided city from the dropdown, click Next, review the summary, click Invite, and stop when the invitation success message is visible

steps.note: Performs and observes the manual invite flow from the already-open drawer, including the required fields and final submission.
Confirms that the manual vendor invitation was sent successfully.
